model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” (y-axis, ranging from 0 to 30 with major gridlines at intervals of 10) of six different language models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine language families or categories (x-axis: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic). Each category on the x-axis displays a group of six colored bars corresponding to the models, as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The heights of the bars vary significantly across categories: for example, in IE-Indic, all models show relatively high effects (peaking at ~24 for mBERT-B₂), while in Uralic, all models show near-zero effects. In Semitic, mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ show moderate effects (~11–16), while mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ show negative or near-zero effects. The chart is not sorted by magnitude; categories appear in a fixed order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
